Privacy Policy — Aura Archana AI

Last Updated: August 11, 2026

1. Introduction

Welcome to Aura Archana AI ("we", "our", or "the App").

Aura Archana AI provides AI-powered Tarot, Numerology, Kundali, Face Reading, Palm Reading, Love Compatibility, and spiritual guidance experiences.

We respect your privacy and are committed to being transparent about how information is collected, used, stored, and shared when you use our application.

By using Aura Archana AI, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We May Collect

Depending on the features you use, Aura Archana AI may process the following information.

Personal information

  • Name, date of birth, birth time, birthplace (for Numerology/Kundali)
  • Gender and language preference (optional)
  • Names and dates of birth you enter in Love Compatibility
  • Questions or intents you voluntarily submit for readings

Photos and camera

  • Face photos for Face Reading (camera or gallery)
  • Palm photos for Palm Reading (camera or gallery)
  • On-device processing may analyze hand landmarks before AI interpretation

Reading information

  • Tarot cards selected, intents, and saved reading history
  • Numerology and Kundali results
  • Face, palm, and love compatibility AI reports
  • Timestamps and reading metadata stored on your device

Device and technical information

  • Device type, Android version, app version
  • IP address, advertising ID, and approximate network information
  • Crash and diagnostic information (when applicable)

We only request information relevant to the feature you choose to use.

3. How We Use Information

We may use information to:

  • Provide Tarot, Numerology, Kundali, Face, Palm, and Love readings
  • Generate personalized AI insights and interpretations
  • Save and display reading history on your device
  • Enforce free vs. premium limits and ad-supported access
  • Improve application functionality and stability
  • Diagnose crashes and technical problems
  • Prevent abuse and misuse
  • Display advertisements and process premium subscriptions
  • Respond to support requests

We do not use your information to make guaranteed predictions about your future.

4. AI-Powered Features

Aura Archana AI uses third-party AI services (such as Google Gemini) to generate personalized interpretations.

Information required to generate a response may be transmitted to our AI service provider. For example:

  • Tarot: selected cards, intent, and your question
  • Numerology/Kundali: calculated values and birth details you provide
  • Face Reading: facial image data encoded for analysis
  • Palm Reading: palm image data and extracted features
  • Love Compatibility: names, dates of birth, and compatibility inputs

We aim to send only information reasonably necessary to provide the requested feature.

AI-generated content is for entertainment and self-reflection and should not be considered guaranteed predictions or professional advice.

5. Advertising

Aura Archana AI may use Google AdMob to display advertisements.

Advertising services may collect or process advertising identifiers, device information, IP address, approximate location, and ad interaction data, subject to Google's policies and your device settings.

The App may use banner, rewarded, and interstitial advertisements. Rewarded ads may allow you to voluntarily watch an advertisement in exchange for unlocking in-app content such as extended AI readings.

6. Premium Subscriptions and Payments

Optional premium subscriptions are processed through Google Play Billing.

Payments are handled by Google Play. We do not directly collect or store your credit card, debit card, or bank account information through the App.

7. Reading History and Local Storage

Profile, settings, and reading history are primarily stored locally on your device using Android DataStore and Room.

You may delete available saved history using in-app deletion features where provided, or by clearing app storage in Android Settings.

8. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal information.

Information may be shared with or processed by service providers when necessary to operate the App, including:

  • AI service providers for AI-generated readings
  • Google AdMob for advertising
  • Google Play for subscription and payment processing
  • Analytics or crash-reporting providers, if implemented

These services process information according to their own privacy policies.

9. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information processed through Aura Archana AI.

However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Avoid entering highly sensitive or confidential information into free-text questions or AI reading requests.

10. Data Retention and Deletion

We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary to provide functionality, maintain reading history, provide support, maintain security, and comply with legal obligations.

To request deletion of information we may hold, contact us with subject Data Deletion Request at support@auraarchana.com.

You can also delete local data via Android Settings → Apps → Aura Archana AI → Clear storage.

11. Children's Privacy

Aura Archana AI is not specifically designed or directed toward children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable laws.

If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.

12. Entertainment Disclaimer

Aura Archana AI provides Tarot, Numerology, Astrology, Kundali, Face Reading, Palm Reading, Love Compatibility, and related AI-generated content for entertainment, personal reflection, and general guidance.

These readings are not scientifically validated predictions, do not guarantee future events, and should not be used as the sole basis for important decisions. They are not medical, mental-health, legal, or financial advice.

13. Third-Party Services

The App may use Google Play Services, Google Play Billing, Google AdMob, and AI service providers. Additional third-party services may be added as the App evolves.

14. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When changes are made, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated policy.

15. Contact
